comment:
No actionable issue found in the source review of `f84e4b1`.

**Verified (source inspection):** The audio panel's three Repeaters now receive plain `{ id, name }` rows instead of live `PwNode` objects. Entries without an ID are omitted; ID `0` is retained. Delegates and keyboard actions resolve a current node, with null guards for nodes that have disappeared.

| Path | Before | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Repeater model | Snapshot of live nodes | Scalar-valued rows |
| Delegate / keyboard action | Uses snapshot node | Looks up current node by ID and name |
| Stream-label matching | Reads node properties | Still receives live stream nodes |

This removes direct QObject model rows from the implicated delegate-creation path. It does not establish that the reported crash is eliminated in a running shell.
